{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-oh-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"8f97a9b8537fc82614fa62c20e8991a09a43c4e91b12e3796f826257e4b21adc","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-oh-class-d:lineage:41","source_registry_sha256":"33124b165dc74fabcff4bbcd8fd15db36bbe4a69a10e7def76a9d71752a5128b","source_liveness_sha256":null},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Sharing the road: first part","heading":"Sharing the road: first part — C","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"FACT_ID: sec10-F01 | anchor: A66
Yield to pedestrians and stay alert because they can be hard to see and may cross outside marked crosswalks or disregard signals. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec10-F02 | anchor: A67
A blind or visually impaired pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog has the right of way. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F03 | anchor: A67
Yield to pedestrians when making a turn. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F04 | anchor: A67
Use extra caution around pedestrians beside parked or stopped vehicles. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F05 | anchor: A67
Before backing, check for pedestrians and other obstacles behind the vehicle. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F06 | anchor: A67
Near playgrounds and in residential areas, stay cautious and ready for a quick stop. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F07 | anchor: A67
Obey the reduced school-zone limit when warning lights flash or children are present, and follow crossing-guard directions near schools. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F08 | anchor: A67
Motorcycle riders have the same roadway rights and duties as other drivers, although they can be harder to see. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F09 | anchor: A67
Give a motorcycle the full width of its lane so its rider has room to respond to other traffic. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F10 | anchor: A67
Include motorcycles in mirror and blind-spot checks. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F11 | anchor: A67
The handbook states that motorcycles require more stopping distance than cars and other passenger vehicles. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F12 | anchor: A67
Do not assume a motorcycle will turn merely because its signal flashes, since the signal may not cancel automatically and may have been left on. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F13 | anchor: A67
At low speed in ideal conditions, keep at least three seconds behind a motorcycle. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F14 | anchor: A68
Use at least four seconds behind a motorcycle with higher speeds, heavy traffic, poor visibility, bad weather, unfamiliar surroundings or driver fatigue. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F15 | anchor: A68
Expect a motorcyclist to change speed or lane position suddenly to avoid potholes, gravel, slippery surfaces, pavement seams, rails or grooved pavement. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F16 | anchor: A68
A bicycle on the roadway is a vehicle and must travel with other traffic rather than against it. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F17 | anchor: A68
Bicycle riders must obey signs, signals and pavement markings and follow the same road rules as motorized traffic. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F18 | anchor: A68
Reduce speed when approaching or passing a bicycle rider. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F19 | anchor: A68
Avoid sounding the horn close to a bicycle rider. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F20 | anchor: A68
Pass a bicycle only when the maneuver can be completed safely. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0068]
